inputKind: a Vector of at least three exact numbers (they may repeat, and may be negative or fractional)

tasks.prompt: Leave the median: the middle number once the numbers are sorted, or the mean of the two middle numbers when the count is even.
tasks.reference: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV

tasks.prompt: Leave the median absolute deviation: the median of the distances (absolute differences) between each number and the median of the numbers.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX SORT 'A' BIND A A LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET A A LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector of the means of every three consecutive numbers, in order (two fewer elements than the input).
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector, as long as the input, whose element at each position is the largest number up to and including that position.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN

tasks.prompt: Leave the number that occurs most often; when several occur equally often, the smallest of them.
tasks.reference: TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES 'C' BIND NIL T KEYS C C 0 [ MAX ] FOLD LT SELECT SORT 0 GET

tasks.prompt: Leave the mean of the numbers after removing one smallest and one largest number.
tasks.reference: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP 'V' BIND V 0 [ ADD ] FOLD V LENGTH DIV
